story: Nora wanted to fly a kite, but the kite was torn. Nora said, “I want to repair the kite.” Dad said, “The boat needs a sail.” Nora said, “I can cover the tear.” She covered the tear with the tape. She launched the kite in the wind. Nora and Dad watched the patched kite. The kite danced above the meadow.
